transfer_contract.test_selection: derive changed Test*/test* callables by AST diff between future base and exact author-head test file
transfer_contract.admission: original future production + exact changed author-test overlay must execute nonempty tests with >=1 failure and zero errors
transfer_contract.applicability: a mechanically changed test contains exactly one direct Boolean assertion f(x) or not f(x), x is parametrized in that test, f resolves to the frozen changed production file, and the frozen primitive one-step attribute projection grammar yields at least one licensed observation class
transfer_contract.observation: same primitive attribute projection closure frozen for attrs; no future semantic names may be added
transfer_contract.selection: minimum depth then lexicographic projection path; extensionally equal observations quotient before selection
transfer_contract.repair: same guarded recursive projection constructor; original body retained after inserted guard
transfer_contract.native_gate: two protected passes + full author test file green; physical withdrawal restores failure; byte-identical restoration passes
transfer_contract.fail_closed: no authentic failure, no direct Boolean residual, no licensed projection, source mismatch, or native non-improvement => exact prospective negative/UNKNOWN; no method mutation

promotion.G2: WARRANTED_BOUNDED_PROSPECTIVE_G2 only if unchanged frozen transfer method generates and causally qualifies a future repair under this heldout source
promotion.negative: if future authentic failure exists but method is inapplicable or cannot repair, record prospective method-family rejection; G2 remains UNKNOWN
promotion.comparator: only if positive future repair qualifies, compare equal-information executable-ledger replay and direct test-derived baseline; no comparator advantage otherwise
